VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 83 tests pass locally, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, diffs, or artifacts) to corroborate this claim. The self-report provides no visibility into:
- What changes were actually made
- Whether the tax computation now uses ship-to address instead of billing address
- Actual test execution results
- Code review or verification of the fix

Without CI logs, diffs, or other independent artifacts, the claim cannot be verified.
